questions.q: How much Bacteriostatic Water should I add to a 10mg peptide vial?
questions.a: For most 10mg vials (such as BPC-157 or TB-500), adding 2.0 mL of Bacteriostatic Water USP creates an ideal concentration of 5.0 mg/mL (5,000 mcg/mL). At this concentration, each 1.0 unit on a U-100 syringe represents exactly 50 mcg, making a standard 250 mcg dose exactly 5.0 units.

questions.q: Why is it dangerous to shake a peptide vial after adding water?
questions.a: Peptides consist of delicate linear amino acid chains stabilized by weak hydrogen and disulfide bonds. Shaking, swirling violently, or vortexing creates severe mechanical shear forces and foaming, causing peptide cleavage, aggregation, and loss of biological integrity. Always roll the vial gently between your palms.

questions.q: Can I use plain sterile water instead of Bacteriostatic Water?
questions.a: Plain sterile water contains no preservative. Once punctured, bacterial endotoxins can multiply within 24–48 hours. Bacteriostatic Water USP contains 0.9% Benzyl Alcohol, preventing bacterial growth and maintaining sterile stability for 21–28 days refrigerated at 2°C–8°C.

questions.q: What should I do if the peptide solution appears cloudy or has floaters?
questions.a: A properly reconstituted peptide must be 100% crystal-clear and free of particulates. If cloudiness persists after gentle rolling, it indicates either incomplete dissolution, solvent pH incompatibility, or denaturation. Do not use cloudy solutions.

questions.q: Why do Low Dead Space (LDS) syringes matter for expensive peptide research?
questions.a: Standard detachable-needle syringes retain up to 0.08 mL (8 units) of fluid inside the needle hub after full depression. With a high-concentration 10 mg/mL solution, that discarded dead space represents 800 mcg of peptide wasted per injection. PepStack LDS syringes integrate the needle directly into the barrel, reducing dead space to under 0.005 mL (<0.5 units) to conserve maximum active compound.

questions.q: What is the difference between BPC-157 Arginate salt and standard BPC-157 Acetate?
questions.a: Standard BPC-157 is synthesized as an acetate salt, which is optimal for subcutaneous injection but hydrolyzes rapidly in gastric acid (pH <2.0). BPC-157 Arginate is a stabilized L-arginine salt that survives simulated gastric juice for over 5 hours, making it the premier benchmark for oral solution delivery and lower GI tract research.

questions.q: How are peptide orders shipped within Metro Manila and nationwide?
questions.a: Metro Manila orders are dispatched via direct express courier inside thermal barrier insulated packaging with cold gel buffers. Nationwide provincial deliveries are handled via J&T Express with priority tracking.

questions.q: Will ambient tropical heat in the Philippines degrade the powder during transit?
questions.a: In their lyophilized (freeze-dried) cake state, peptides are thermodynamically stable and withstand ambient temperatures (20°C–25°C) for up to 72–96 hours without measurable loss of purity. Refrigeration (2°C–8°C) is strictly required only after adding diluent.

questions.q: What should I do immediately upon receiving my package?
questions.a: Unpack the shipment immediately and transfer all unopened lyophilized peptide vials into a -20°C freezer (for long-term storage up to 36 months) or a 2°C–8°C refrigerator (for use within 6–12 months). Keep vials protected from UV light.

questions.q: How does aqueous stability dating apply to reconstituted peptide multi-dose vials?
questions.a: Under standard GLP laboratory protocols for multi-dose preserved vials, solutions reconstituted with 0.9% Benzyl Alcohol (Bacteriostatic Water) maintained under continuous refrigeration (2°C–8°C) possess a validated 28-day analytical stability window. Freezing reconstituted solutions is strictly discouraged, as ice crystal formation shears peptide bonds.

questions.q: Are these compounds approved for human consumption?
questions.a: Strictly NO. All compounds, formulations, and diluents distributed by PepStack Labs are manufactured exclusively for in vitro laboratory research, analytical chemical assays, and receptor affinity studies. They are not intended for human or animal diagnostic, therapeutic, or clinical administration.

questions.q: How can I verify the purity of my batch?
questions.a: Every batch produced is tested via Reverse-Phase High-Performance Liquid Chromatography (RP-HPLC) and Electrospray Ionization Mass Spectrometry (ESI-MS). You can view third-party Certificates of Analysis directly in our CoA Directory (/research-library#coa).

questions.q: Why is a 4-week stepwise titration strictly enforced for dual/triple incretins?
questions.a: GLP-1, GIP, and Amylin receptors in the area postrema and enteric nervous system require progressive receptor adaptation. Escalating doses at 4-week intervals (e.g. 2.5mg -> 5.0mg -> 7.5mg for Tirzepatide) prevents acute receptor saturation, severe nausea, and vomiting while ensuring steady-state pharmacokinetics.

beginnerSopSteps.title: Sterile Workstation & Disinfection
beginnerSopSteps.instruction: Clean laboratory benchtop with 70% Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA). Inspect the glass vial for micro-cracks. Pop the plastic flip-top seal and vigorously swab the rubber septum with a sterile alcohol pad. Allow 30 seconds to air-dry completely.

beginnerSopSteps.title: Diluent Draw & Vacuum Management
beginnerSopSteps.instruction: Using a sterile 20G–22G reconstitution syringe, draw the exact volume of Bacteriostatic Water USP (typically 2.0 mL for a 10mg vial). Note that lyophilized vials are factory-sealed under vacuum; maintain firm grip on the plunger to avoid sudden snap-back.

beginnerSopSteps.title: 45° Glass Wall Injection
beginnerSopSteps.instruction: Insert the needle through the center of the rubber stopper at a 45-degree angle pointing directly against the inner glass wall. Slowly depress plunger so diluent runs smoothly down the glass. NEVER spray diluent directly onto the powder cake, as impact causes protein shearing.

beginnerSopSteps.title: Circular Rolling Dissolution
beginnerSopSteps.instruction: Withdraw needle. Gently roll the vial horizontally between your palms or in slow circular motions on the benchtop for 60–90 seconds. NEVER shake, shake-mix, or vortex. Once solution is 100% transparent and particulate-free, transfer immediately to 2°C–8°C refrigeration.
